verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents two types of ranking rules, built-in and custom, and lets you reorder the seven built-in rules, including a 'sort' rule. Its Dynamic Search Rules can boost, pin, or bury results per request, and a personalization feature adapts ranking to each user. A community user, however, reports that decay functions for phasing out results by age or distance are missing, which limits recency-style business signals. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing custom rules on business attributes (popularity, margin, timestamp asc/desc), decay/recency functions, and independent hands-on corroboration of custom ranking in practice.
